title: Finite classical scalar extension and locally closed restriction
statement: Fix D,l,hl and realization families a,b. Given a finite classical realization Family s, normalized pullback comparisons of a and normalized coefficient-change comparisons of a, there exists Operations s. At a finite coefficient inclusion, this uses the actual ramified finite-level tensor with exponent (m+e)/e-1, its quotient transitions, tensor units, induced completion-cone maps and raw fraction formulas. Locally closed restriction uses the actual levelwise etale inverse image, adjunction unit and its site-comparison mate. Both comparisons have the prescribed ordinary_tensor and raw normalization equations. This asserts neither identity/composition coherence nor common-stage descent. Interfaces: [def-zl-classical-raw-lisse-realization-data], [def-zl-classical-raw-lisse-operations], [def-real-lisse-pullback-normalization], [def-real-lisse-field-normalization]. Additional interface owners: [def-real-lisse-realization-data], [def-per-continuous-rational-realization-data], [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], [def-per-adic-base-stages].

proof.text: At a coefficient inclusion of ramification e, take at level m the actual balanced tensor of level (m+e)/e-1 with the target quotient ring. Tensoring a finite local basis proves finite freeness; base change of the quotient maps proves the normalization of the resulting system. The adjunction tensor units define the level units. Their compatibility with transitions induces the integralUnit by the universal property of the completion cone, with precisely the asserted projection equation.

source.place: Proposition 6.8.4(1),(3),(4), Remark 6.8.15; original node step 6 before the coherence equations

proof.text: For restriction, apply the actual etale inverse image levelwise, with its adjunction unit. The site-comparison adjoint mate induces the map of completion cones, giving the specified integralUnit and projection equation. Local finite bases prove that both operations commute with module inverse image and coefficient extension. Extend their compatible-family maps by scalar localization; the balanced relation gives the stated fraction formulas, and additivity and functoriality follow on pure tensors.

proof.text: The prescribed raw realization comparison is obtained from these actual module comparisons using the normalized lisse pullback and field comparisons of a. On local generators 1 tensor x the comparison is the completion-cone map just constructed; this proves ordinary_tensor and normalization. The same construction on finite stalks and their inverse limit gives the scalar fibre isomorphism.
